Neil Armstrong served as a U.S. Navy pilot in the **Korean War**.  
The fighting officially ended when the Korean Armistice Agreement was signed, which took place on **27 July 1953**.  The armistice ended hostilities on the Korean Peninsula, though no formal peace treaty has been signed since.
